title: Lower bound on the probability of hitting a target
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of positive degree $D$ such that $D\leq 2|V|$, where $|V|$ is the number of vertices. If there is a path from $s$ to $t$ (allowing a path of length zero), then a uniformly chosen sequence of $100|V|^4$ neighbor indices, followed from $s$, visits $t$ with probability at least $3/4$.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a regular multigraph of degree $D$
